devdoc.details: Main contract integrating all management functionalities with access control.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

disableRewardTarget(address).details: This function can only be called by the protocol owner.Reverts if the provided address is invalid (address(0)).

params._rewardTargetAddress: The address of the reward target to disable.

params._handler: Address of the external swap handler to be disabled in the registry

params._token: Address of the token to be disabled.

enableRewardTarget(address).details: This function can only be called by the protocol owner.Reverts if the provided address is invalid (address(0)).

params._rewardTargetAddress: The address of the reward target to enable.

enableRewardTargets(address[]).details: This function can only be called by the protocol owner.Reverts if the provided address array is empty.

params._rewardTargetAddresses: The addresses of the reward targets to enable.

enableSolverHandler(address).details: This function can only be called by the protocol owner.Reverts if the provided handler address is invalid (address(0)).

params._handler: The address of the solver handler to enable.

params._tokens: Array of token addresses to be enabled.

params._rewardTargetAddress: The address of the reward target to check.

returns._0: Boolean indicating if the reward target address is enabled.

params._handler: Address of the external swap handler to be checked

returns._0: Boolean parameter for is the external swap handler enabled or not

params._token: Address of the token to check.

returns._0: True if the token is enabled, otherwise false.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params._assetLimit: Maximum number of allowed assets in the fund

params._newCooldownPeriod: The new cooldown period in seconds.

setEmergencyPause(bool,bool).details: This function can be called by the protocol owner at any time, or by any user if the protocol has been      paused for at least 4 weeks. Users can only unpause the protocol and are restricted from pausing it.      The function includes a 5-minute cooldown between unpauses to prevent rapid toggling.Emits a state change to the emergency pause status of the protocol.

params._state: Boolean parameter to set the pause (true) or unpause (false) state of the protocol.
params._unpauseProtocol: Boolean parameter to determine if the protocol should be unpaused.

params._whitelistLimit: Maximum number of allowed whitelist users and tokens in the fund

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

updatePriceOracle(address).details: Updates the price oracle contract address.

params._newOracle: Address of the new price oracle contract.

updateVelvetTreasury(address).details: Updates the address of the treasury.

upgradeTo(address).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.
